find_files.description: Find visible files below a directory. Both arguments are required: path is a normalized Git-style repository-relative directory using / on every operating system, including Windows (use an empty string for the root); pattern uses the same path format relative to path, where * matches one path segment and ** matches any number of segments (use ** for every descendant). Returns at most 200 paths without pagination; when truncated is true, narrow path or pattern and retry.

grep.description: Search visible UTF-8 text without pagination. pattern, path, and file_pattern are required: pattern is a Python regular expression of at most 512 characters; path is a repository-relative file or directory and uses an empty string for the repository root; file_pattern is a path-segment-aware glob relative to path and use ** to include every visible file. Scans at most 1 MiB and returns at most 200 matches; when truncated is true, narrow pattern, path, or file_pattern and retry.

read_file.description: Read a visible file with required path and version current|base|head. The inclusive one-based start_line and end_line may both be omitted for a bounded whole-file read; otherwise both must be provided. Reads at most 500 lines: current is the verified frozen content and may include the captured overlay; base and head are the pinned Git revisions. Binary files and Snapshot sources larger than 1 MiB are rejected, and output is limited to 64 KiB; when truncated is true, retry with a narrower explicit line range.

get_diff.description: Read the verified base-to-current diff for one changed visible path. current is frozen Review content and may include the captured workspace overlay, while base is the pinned base revision. Output is limited to 64 KiB.

comment.description: Submit 1 to 20 concrete findings in comments. Every item requires path, side, existing_code, title, content, recommendation, category, severity, and confidence. Use side=old for base-version removed lines shown after - markers, or side=new for target-version added lines shown after + markers. existing_code must quote the smallest exact sequence containing only changed lines on that side, without diff markers. Do not include unchanged diff context. severity is critical|high|medium|low|info and confidence is between 0 and 1. Candidates are resolved independently; rejected_comments reports zero-based input indices and reasons. Retry only those rejected indices because accepted candidates are retained.

review_file_done.description: Declare one or more Review files investigated. reviewed_files must contain 1 to 2000 exact paths from review_files. A path is recorded only after a successful model-visible get_diff or read_file call for that path; otherwise the result rejects it in missing_evidence_files. Repeated paths are idempotent.

task_done.description: Attempt to finish the whole investigation. summary is required and contains 1 to 8000 characters. The result rejects completion while Review files remain: missing_evidence_files were not successfully viewed with get_diff or read_file; undeclared_files were viewed but not recorded with review_file_done. Continue reviewing and retry task_done. After the configured rejection limit, completion is accepted with incomplete_files so existing findings can still be finalized.
